items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: we had a little trombone player, who played - Mouse Powell... Mousey Powell and his 'Neon' trombone and, of course, we went right on doing the show

ctx.x: Mousey Powell and his "Neon" trombone and, of course, we went right on doing the show---Meroff carried his own stage -- we set up a whole stage whenever we went - it was all done by train. And, if we played in the ballroom a big stage was set up. And, I think, there's a picture you have of me in front of the Corn Palace---
